title: Phase D: institutional order flow (Dukascopy top of book), lower-timeframe validation (MT5 / Dukascopy M1) and incremental predictive value on the unchanged +-$15 benchmark
status: REGISTERED, NOT RUN (no Dukascopy, MT5 or broker data received; every result document reads INSUFFICIENT DATA - RESEARCH INCOMPLETE)
approval_note: Development and the unsealed 2026 period need no approval (harness.partition). Validation and holdout stay sealed; opening validation would need a separate amendment with approved_by_operator true, written on the operator's explicit instruction, never self-approved.

sealed.rule: never downloaded (d_dukascopy.check_span / hours_of refuse it before any request; b5c_dukascopy.day_hours skips it), never kept from an MT5 export (mt5_m1_check.partition_guard drops and only counts those rows), never scored

preserves.phase_c: frozen evidence: research/PHASE_C_FROZEN.sha256 pins 74 files (reports, results, registrations B26-B29 and the code that produced them); tests/test_phase_c_frozen.py fails on any change, and on any change to the first 3,808 lines of research/trials.jsonl. Phase C's verdict NO QUALIFIED STRATEGY stands and is not revisited by parameter changes.
preserves.benchmark: B26 unchanged (quantum/research/b26.py, pinned): BUY +15 TP vs -15 SL, SELL -15 TP vs +15 SL, from the fill, bid / ask execution, 192 bars, closures, AMBIGUOUS = stop; k = price / 4000 in development, 1 in 2026; ENG costs primary. Phase D builds its labels through b27.labels, i.e. the same function and populations as Phase C (b27.load_pops conventions), so the benchmark reproduces Phase C exactly.
preserves.separation: Four tracks are kept apart, each with its own family for multiple-testing: (1) the benchmark itself (descriptive, B26); (2) the order-flow-informed +-$15 strategy family (Workstreams D/E); (3) the dynamic TP / SL family (ATR brackets); (4) descriptive measurements (P(favourable), adverse-first, time to exit, delay, the one-minute grid, stop entries, spread effects). B5c (research/registrations/B5C.json, 33 trials, the -$10 stop) remains its own registered experiment on the same downloaded data.
preserves.production: Nothing in quantum/ outside quantum/research, site/, relay/, artefacts/, alerts, keys or MT5 execution is changed (tests/test_integrity.py: production never imports research).

hypotheses.H-D1: Order flow adds out-of-sample information about the +-$15 race: set B beats Baseline on multinomial log-loss (incremental test, one-sided p < 0.05 after Holm over the four algorithms).
hypotheses.H-D2: An order-flow-informed rule (set B or D, any registered algorithm and rule) meets all of C1-C6.
hypotheses.H-D3: Volatility / structure (set A) beats Baseline (Phase C suggests not; tested for completeness on identical rows).
hypotheses.H-D4: Intermarket (set C) beats Baseline - only if intermarket data are genuinely supplied; otherwise NOT RUN.
hypotheses.H-D5: Combined (set D) beats set A (order flow adds to price structure).
hypotheses.H-D6: (descriptive) order flow changes P(favourable $5/$10/$15/$20 within 4 h), P(adverse $X before favourable $X), the time to exit, and the value of delaying an entry by one bar.
hypotheses.H-D7: (descriptive, Workstream B) one-minute bid / ask resolves Phase C's 15-minute bounds: B26's AMBIGUOUS trades, the $3-$10 brackets (B29: INCONCLUSIVE at 15m), stop entries, and the real spread against the modelled one.
hypotheses.prior: Every price-only family in Phase B and C failed; the models' AUC came from the calendar (closures), not direction (research/PHASE_C_REPORT.md). The prior for any edge is therefore low; correlation is not taken as prediction, and prediction is not taken as profit.

dukascopy.what: SWFX (Dukascopy's ECN) best bid and best offer with the volume displayed at each, at every change; datafeed hour files <SYM>/<YYYY>/<MM-1>/<DD>/<HH>h_ticks.bi5 (LZMA, records >3I2f: ms in hour, ask, bid, ask volume, bid volume; prices in integer units, scale detected against the spot paths)
dukascopy.is_not: order-book depth beyond the best level, traded volume, trade sign or CME data. Volumes are indicative displayed liquidity on one venue. Feature names say quote, never trade or depth.
dukascopy.periods: development 2020-01-24 02:00 -> 2023-01-24 02:00 UTC; 2026-01-01 00:00 UTC -> the last complete UTC day
dukascopy.where: downloaded and reduced on the operator's computer (Dukascopy refuses GitHub's servers and its terms restrict redistribution); raw ticks are never committed or uploaded; the per-bar sums stay in the local cache

intermarket.source: Dukascopy datafeed, same format: EURUSD, XAGUSD, DOLLARIDXUSD (US dollar index CFD), USTBONDTRUSD (US T-bond CFD: a price, an inverse proxy of long yields, NOT the 10-year yield)
intermarket.availability: probed (one hour each) before download; an instrument not served is reported unavailable and set C / D run without it, never with a substitute
intermarket.not_available: COMEX GC order flow (paid; B5 used Databento once), intraday DXY / US10Y history outside 2026, historical news timestamps outside the dated lists (b8_news, news_calendar): 2026-01 -> 2026-10 news is NOT DATED and stays so; nothing is fabricated

data.spot_paths: Twelve Data XAU/USD 15m / 1h on the research-data branch (+ the live store for late 2026), exactly Phase C's populations

mt5_m1.format: MT5 View -> Symbols -> Bars -> M1 -> Export Bars: <DATE> <TIME> <OPEN> <HIGH> <LOW> <CLOSE> <TICKVOL> <VOL> <SPREAD>, server time, BID prices, spread in points (research/PHASE_D_DATA_REQUIREMENTS.md section 3)
mt5_m1.validator: research/tools/mt5_m1_check.py (Phase D version): encoding, separator, explicit dates, server zone incl. NY+7, partition guard, per-week clock, discontinuities, scale changes, coverage, broker identification; USABLE only with a passed clock check
mt5_m1.status: not received; no observation is invented or substituted

timestamp_alignment.dukascopy: B5c amendments A1 / A2, unchanged and applied per period (development and 2026 separately): lag correlation of 15-minute mid changes vs the spot closes at -2..+2 bars, overall, by session and by year; best lag must be 0 with r(0) >= 0.8; weekly open / close edges; basis by session; duplicate ms, crossed quotes, out-of-hour ticks, stale bars; days with median |basis| > 0.5% or r < 0.5 are quarantined (set missing), never shifted; the run stops if > 5% of days are quarantined, crossed quotes > 1%, out-of-hour > 0.1%, or the weekly edges differ by > 15 minutes
timestamp_alignment.coverage: the run stops (INSUFFICIENT DATA) if fewer than 90% of a period's scored spot bars have Dukascopy ticks (d_run.MIN_OF_COVERAGE)
timestamp_alignment.mt5: per-ISO-week lag check at -4..+4 hours (>= 200 overlapping 15m bars per week); any misaligned week makes the file NOT USABLE; --suggest-zone is information for the operator, never applied
timestamp_alignment.never: timestamps are never shifted to improve alignment or results
timestamp_alignment.phase_d_a1: beyond the lag-0 gate (quantum/research/d_clock.py): 15-minute lags -2..+2 per ISO week (>= 200 bars; a week is misaligned when lag 0 is not among the tied best, within 0.001 of the maximum correlation; misaligned weeks are quarantined, and more than 2% of weeks stops the run); the one-minute mid read at the spot close shifted by -5..+5 minutes (0 must be among the tied best, the tied set within +-3 minutes); with an MT5 export, one-minute bid changes Dukascopy vs broker at -5..+5 minutes overall and per week (same rules); ticks whose millisecond stamp runs backwards inside an hour file at most 0.1% of ticks

order_flow.code: quantum/research/d_features.order_flow (row i uses ticks of bar i and earlier: known at its close)
order_flow.sums: d_dukascopy.PD_COLS plus B5c's SUM_COLS, per 15-minute bar

features.baseline: B27's audited features (research/FEATURE_AUDIT.md) of families TIME_NEWS and MOMENTUM (b27.FAMILY_OF): time, session, news proximity where dated, returns, wicks, runs
features.A: Baseline + B27 families VOLATILITY, TREND, STRUCTURE_SMC, LIQUIDITY
features.C: Baseline + intermarket: sg_im_<sym>_r1 / _r4 (1- and 4-bar log returns of each available instrument's 15-minute mid, read at the same close)
features.excluded: B27's ENGINE and MARKOV families (the engine's own signals; the HMM needs hmmlearn on the laptop) are in no set
features.explanatory_vs_period: no calendar-period identifier (year, month, quarter) is a feature; session / hour / weekday are explanatory and part of Baseline, so the calendar effect Phase C found sits in the Baseline every set is compared with

labels.benchmark: B26's outcome, three classes: TP / SL (AMBIGUOUS counts as SL) / NEITHER (TIMEOUT or CLOSURE); OPEN excluded (d_study.y3)
labels.dynamic: a separate family: TP / SL = (1.0, 1.0), (1.5, 1.0), (1.0, 1.5) x the 15-minute ATR(14) at the decision, resolved on Dukascopy one-minute bid / ask with B26's rules and ENG slippage / commission (d_run.dynamic_labels); not run without one-minute data for both periods

descriptive.FAV5 / FAV10 / FAV15 / FAV20: the trigger side reaches +$X (x k) from the fill within 16 bars (no race)
descriptive.ADV_FIRST5 / 10 / 15 / 20: the +-$X race from the same fill: favourable first / adverse first / neither; on one-minute bid / ask when available, else 15 minutes worst case, flagged INCONCLUSIVE when AMBIGUOUS > 2%
descriptive.time: median minutes to TP and to SL by quintile of P(TP), and for every strategy
descriptive.delay: the paired net change from entering one bar later, split by order flow with / against the trade

labels.never: outcome definitions are not changed after results; no losing trade is removed; OPEN trades are the only exclusion

algorithms.LGBM: LightGBM(400 trees, 31 leaves, lr 0.05, min_child_samples 200, subsample 0.8)
algorithms.source: b22.make, unchanged from Phase B / C; no hyper-parameter is searched

models.output: multinomial P(TP), P(SL), P(NEITHER) (sum to 1), E[net] = P(TP) W + P(SL) L + P(NEITHER) N (USD / oz, ENG) with W / L / N from the fit rows of the same direction; uncertainty: Wilson intervals per reliability bin, block-bootstrap intervals for every strategy figure
models.calibration: one temperature per fit, from the training window's own last 20% (b27.split_fit_cal); never from a test, 2026 or sealed row
models.walk_forward: quarterly folds from 2021-01-01; a training row must have exited one day before the fold; the same folds and rows for every set and algorithm; final models refit on all development and applied ONCE to 2026

rules.Q10 / Q05 / Q02: top 10 / 5 / 2% of E[net], thresholds per direction from the training window's calibration rows

models.positions: one per direction at a time (b27.seq_rows): every counted trade is independent of the one before

costs.primary: ENG: spread 0.30 in session / 0.50 off session, slippage 0.20 in and 0.20 out on stops, commission 0.07 (USD / oz, x k in development)
costs.also: GROSS, OP and ADV are carried by the labels (B26) for sensitivity; the one-minute race uses the real Dukascopy spread with ENG slippage and commission
costs.account: account-currency P&L only from a VALIDATED broker specification (d_broker), reported next to, never instead of, USD / oz; the balance is never an optimisation input

tests.incremental: per set vs Baseline, same algorithm and rows: mean daily out-of-sample log-loss improvement, stationary bootstrap (mean block 5 days, 2,000 draws), one-sided p; reported with the AUCs, never instead of the net figures
tests.family_benchmark: every (set, algorithm, rule) strategy on the +-$15 labels: up to 5 x 4 x 4 = 80; BH at q = 0.10 on the one-sided binomial p against matched random (direction x session x month, b27.base_rates); White's Reality Check (1,000 stationary-bootstrap draws, mean block 10) on daily net R against no trade
tests.family_dynamic: 3 brackets x 3 sets x 2 algorithms x 4 rules = 72, its own BH and Reality Check
tests.frozen: a strategy is frozen for the 2026 check when it passes BH (q = 0.10), has positive development expectancy and at least 300 independent trades; Holm over the frozen set on 2026
tests.no_tuning: no threshold, weight, window or hyper-parameter is chosen on results; a fixed list is evaluated once

acceptance.C1: positive net expectancy (ENG) in the development walk-forward AND in 2026 (frozen model, applied once)
acceptance.C2: the Wilson lower bound of the decided TP-first rate exceeds matched random in development AND in 2026
acceptance.C3: BH-significant at q = 0.10 in its family, the family's Reality Check p < 0.05, and Holm p < 0.05 on 2026
acceptance.C4: positive expectancy in every development year with >= 30 trades and in 2026, in >= 2 of 3 volatility terciles and >= 2 of 3 trend states (each >= 30 trades)
acceptance.C5: at least 300 independent trades in development (500 preferred, reported)
acceptance.C6: P(drawdown >= 15R within 250 trades) <= 5% by block bootstrap (blocks of 10), 1R = the stop distance; account-level drawdown and ruin reported only from a verified broker specification
acceptance.qualifies: all six; the final recommendation is QUALIFIES FOR FURTHER VALIDATION (then validation is opened only by an operator-approved amendment, once), NO QUALIFIED STRATEGY, or INSUFFICIENT DATA - RESEARCH INCOMPLETE (a data gate failed, or 2026 order flow is unusable so C1 cannot be assessed)
acceptance.90_percent: a win rate is never optimised at the expense of expectancy or drawdown: a rule is judged on net expectancy, drawdown and frequency, and its win rate is reported against its own break-even

null_and_synthetic: the pipeline is tested only on synthetic data (tests/test_research_phase_d_*.py): a planted order-flow edge must be found and two nulls must not be; synthetic results are never reported as findings and synthetic order flow is never used in place of quotes

outputs.local (operator's computer): phase_d_out/: data_report.json, study.json, questions.json, m1.json, dynamic.json (aggregate figures), trades/*.csv (independent trades: times, direction, outcome, net USD / oz, minutes, session; no prices), and phase_d_trials.jsonl (hash-chained)
outputs.committed: those files once received (no Dukascopy or MT5 price is in them), research/PHASE_D_*.md filled from them by a script, every trial appended to research/phase_d_trials.jsonl
outputs.trade_files: phase_d_out/trades/benchmark/<set>_<algo>_<rule>__dev.csv and __2026.csv (frozen only), trades/dynamic/ATR<tp>_<sl>/...: the independent trades of EVERY strategy, whatever its result, price-free columns only (d_run.TRADE_COLS); each file's SHA-256 is in its trial record
outputs.audit_d4: research/tools/phase_d_audit.py: chain and registration hash; one trial record per strategy; file hashes; every figure recomputed from the trade files; BH recomputed; partitions; gates and verdict
outputs.appendix: research/tools/phase_d_reports.py: PHASE_D_APPENDIX.md generated from the outputs only, written only when the D4 audit passes

compute.download: about 22,000 development + 5,500 2026 hour files (2-4 GB transferred, ~200-400 MB cached as sums and minute bars), 30-90 minutes on a home connection at 6 workers, resumable; intermarket 4 x as many, optional, a few hours
compute.study: 20 benchmark walk-forwards (5 sets x 4 algorithms, 8 quarterly folds) + 18 dynamic + 48 descriptive; about 2-4 hours on a 4-core laptop (RF and GB dominate), resumable by stage
compute.m1: about 2.3 million one-minute races per period, 5-15 minutes

amendments.change: Timestamp verification beyond B5c's lag-0 gate (the operator's brief: lag 0 alone is not proof): per-week 15-minute lags, a minute-offset check on Dukascopy's one-minute mid, the MT5 cross-check, and a backwards-timestamp count (new extraction column ms_backwards), with tie-aware rules (a tie is not a shift; nothing is ever shifted). Trade-level files for every strategy, hashed into the log; the D4 audit tool and the generated appendix. The defect behind part of this: d_run defined write_trades but never called it, so the registered run would have written no trade-level files.
